```

BiocManager::install(c("Statial", "spicyR", "lisaClust", "mistyR", "imcRtools",
                       "imcdatasets", "treekoR", "ClassifyR"))
```

## Data

```{r data}
library(Statial); library(SingleCellExperiment)
data("kerenSCE")                 # Keren 2018 TNBC MIBI-TOF: 10 images, 36 proteins, survival
nCores <- 4
```

## 1. Statial: SpatioMark. Marker changes vs. proximity (a proteomics ctSVP analogue)

The question: *does marker m in cell type A change with distance to (or local abundance of) cell type B?*
This is a ctSV test with an interpretable spatial covariate.

```{r spatiomark}
kerenSCE <- getDistances(kerenSCE, maxDist = 200, nCores = nCores)   # distance of each cell to nearest cell of each type
kerenSCE <- getAbundances(kerenSCE, r = 200, nCores = nCores)        # abundance of each type within radius r

# One image, one relationship
one <- calcStateChanges(cells = kerenSCE, type = "distances", image = "6",
                        from = "Keratin_Tumour", to = "Macrophages", marker = "p53",
                        nCores = nCores)

# All images / cell-type pairs / markers
sc_all <- calcStateChanges(cells = kerenSCE, type = "distances", nCores = nCores, minCells = 100)
head(sc_all[order(sc_all$pval), ])

# Patient-level state-change matrix -> survival (biomarker!)
mat <- prepMatrix(sc_all)
# then e.g. survival::coxph or spicyR::colTest(mat, condition = ...)
```

## 2. Statial: Kontextual. Context-aware cell–cell localisation

```{r kontextual}
biologicalHierarchy <- list(
  tumour  = c("Keratin_Tumour", "Tumour"),
  tcells  = c("CD3_Cell", "CD4_Cell", "CD8_Cell", "Tregs"),
  myeloid = c("Dc/Mono", "DC", "Mono/Neu", "Macrophages", "Neutrophils"),
  tissue  = c("Endothelial", "Mesenchymal"))
parentDf <- parentCombinations(all = unique(kerenSCE$cellType), biologicalHierarchy)
kont <- Kontextual(cells = kerenSCE, r = 100, parentDf = parentDf, cores = nCores)
head(kont)
```

## 3. spicyR: does co-localisation differ between groups or predict survival?

```{r spicyr}
library(spicyR)
# condition = a patient-level column, e.g. tumour class or response; subject handles multiple images per patient
colnames(colData(kerenSCE))   # pick a patient-level grouping column (or use survival: Survival_days_capped + Censored)
res <- spicy(kerenSCE, condition = "tumour_type", subject = "imageID")   # replace "tumour_type" with your column
topPairs(res)
signifPlot(res)
```

## 4. lisaClust: spatial regions from local L-functions

```{r lisaclust}
library(lisaClust)
kerenSCE <- lisaClust(kerenSCE, k = 5)
hatchingPlot(kerenSCE, useImages = "6")
# region proportions per patient are candidate biomarkers; test them with spicyR::colTest / survival
```

## 5. mistyR: intracellular vs. neighbourhood marker dependencies

```{r misty}
library(mistyR); library(dplyr)
img  <- kerenSCE[, kerenSCE$imageID == "6"]
expr <- as.data.frame(t(assay(img, "intensities")))
pos  <- as.data.frame(colData(img)[, c("x", "y")])
create_initial_view(expr) %>%
  add_juxtaview(pos, neighbor.thr = 15) %>%
  add_paraview(pos, l = 50) %>%
  run_misty(results.folder = "misty_results")
misty <- collect_results("misty_results")
plot_improvement_stats(misty)     # which markers are explained by the spatial context
plot_interaction_heatmap(misty, view = "para.50")
```

## 6. imcRtools: spatial graphs + histoCAT-style interaction tests (Bodenmiller workflow)

```{r imcrtools}
library(imcRtools); library(imcdatasets)
spe <- JacksonFischer_2020_BreastCancer(data_type = "spe")   # big; try IMMUcan_2022_CancerExample() first
spe <- buildSpatialGraph(spe, img_id = "image_name", type = "knn", k = 10)
spe <- aggregateNeighbors(spe, colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph",
                          aggregate_by = "metadata", count_by = "cell_type")
out <- testInteractions(spe, group_by = "image_name", label = "cell_type",
                        colPairName = "knn_interaction_graph", iter = 1000)
# Column names (image_name / cell_type) vary by dataset; check colnames(colData(spe)).
```
